goal: Classify rental devices and create them through a backend-authoritative category/model catalog.
test_paths: cd camera-rental-admin && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/deviceCatalogModel.test.ts && pnpm ts:check
non_goals: Do not apply the migration to an unidentified database.
Do not modify return registration, device assignment, schedule, warehouse return or inspection behavior.
Do not commit, push or deploy in this task.
expected_evidence: Seven focused backend tests for catalog, create validation, stand codes and ERP inbound classification
Admin TypeScript check and local production-equivalent build
Same-origin browser interaction evidence for all seven categories
unsafe_assumptions: Frontend linked selects do not replace backend validation.
Unknown historical or ERP model codes cannot be silently classified.
Mock browser interaction is not live backend E2E.
stop_condition: Stop if the implementation moves catalog authority into the frontend, breaks unknown ERP models, or requires applying migration 049 without an identified target.
